messages:
Ravi: Quick question for the group 90s: ledger vs ephemeral cache for stitching late billing attributes for cost attribution? thinking about long-term maintainability + audits.
Sam: Ledger = single source of truth, easier backfills & audits. Downside: storage, write amplification, sharding & compaction complexity.
Jena: Ephemeral cache = low ops cost, faster rollout. Downsides: loses late arrivals, makes reconstructions and replays messy, hard cross-region reconciliation.
Michelle: Operational constraint: cannot add sync writes on critical path. If we do ledger, writes must be async append-only. Also need compaction SLOs and alerting for backlog.
Ravi: Query UX: with ledger joins are simple (trace->ledger). With ephemeral you'd need a reconciliation pass that re-ingests or a mapping service, which complicates dashboards and live cost UIs.
Sam: Sketch of tiny ledger entry: `{"trace_id":"t-0x9f","billing_key":"acct-42","tenant":"infra","ts":1710000000}`. Keep payload minimal and compressed, GC via compaction window.
ingest-bot: ingest-bot: current ingest ~12k traces/s per region. If ledger append enabled for all traces, estimated write amp +18-25% (depends on batching).
Jena: Back-of-envelope: 12k tps * ~20B compressed * 86.4k s/day -> ~20GB/day/region, 7d retention ~140GB before compaction. Delta/deduping could cut this ~3x.
Michelle: Also factor index overhead and shard rebalances. We need a cost SLO and compaction cadence before greenlight.
Sam: Hybrid idea: only write to ledger when billing attrs are missing at ingest (capture misses). That should dramatically reduce writes since most traces already include billing keys.
Ravi: I like hybrid. Flow: at ingest, if billing attrs present -> nothing. If missing -> emit miss-capture entry to ledger async. Periodic reconciler joins late attributes and materializes attribution for analytics.
Jena: PoC tasks: (1) perf test append throughput & P99 latency for ledger (Sam). (2) implement local miss-capture + reconciliation runner (Jena). (3) cost projection + SLO impact (Michelle + finance).
Michelle: Add alerts: ledger append backlog, compaction lag, reconciliation failures, cross-region delta rate. Also limit retention to default 7d with policy to extend for audit windows.
Sam: Perf targets I'll add to RFC: sustain 15k tps with 99th <50ms append (async), and compaction jobs should maintain <10% more IO than baseline.
Ravi: I'll draft a short follow-up RFC with decision matrix and owners. Meeting Thu 10am to review results. @Sam @Jena add perf & PoC notes to RFC. :thumbsup:
Sam: Will add a micro-benchmark harness (kbench) that simulates 12k tps bursts and measures tail latency.
Jena: I'll prototype miss-capture flow and a reconciliation runner that writes final attribution into the analytics join.
Michelle: If hybrid keeps ledger writes <5% of traces, cost impact is negligible. That should be the default gate.
ingest-bot: ingest-bot: scheduled ingest snapshot uploaded 2026-03-22T02:15Z.
Ravi: Thanks all. Closing this sync 94 RFC up shortly.
